snippet.title: Go Slimey Go! - Announcement Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020563/

The award-winning 2D precision platformer is coming to PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, published worldwide by ESDigital Games.

Bounce, slide and launch Slimey through five colorful handcrafted worlds packed with secrets, collectibles, alternative routes and plenty of surprises. Built around momentum, exploration and satisfying movement, Go Slimey Go! is easy to pick up, but offers plenty of challenge for players looking to master every jump.

#ps5 #ps5games #ps4 #ps4games
